structures.description: Broad two-sided trading range spanning the whole window; floor anchored by 2357.18 and 2358.62, ceiling by 2680.00 and 2700.00. Legs overlap with repeated reversals and no sustained one-directional sequence.
Bull leg from the 2358.62 low (open 1789488000000) to the 2700 high (open 1789804800000); higher highs and higher lows with two large bull bars, ending at a 2638.49 close.
Bar with open 1789804800000 printed a 2700 high (round number) and closed 2638.49, leaving a 61.51 upper tail; a possible exhaustion probe at the top of the range.
Congestion after the 2680.00 spike: overlapping bars holding between 2464.27 and 2609.02 from open 1789142400000 to close 1789473599999.

evidence_for: Across 120 bars price repeatedly reversed inside the 2357.18-2700 band: a 2357-2359 double bottom, a 2680 spike that closed 124.48 below its high, a two-sided 2464.27-2609.02 congestion, a 2358.62 retest, and a 2700 probe that closed 61.51 below its high.
Overlap and reversal count dominate: bodies in the 2464-2609 congestion repeatedly overlap and no more than a few trend bars run consecutively in either direction.
The 2700 high exceeded the earlier 2680.00 high by only 20 points and closed back inside the prior range, so acceptance above the top is unproven.
evidence_against: Strongest counterargument: from the 2358.62 low (open 1789488000000) the sequence steps up in both highs and lows into 2700, which is a directional bull leg rather than rotation, and it includes large trend bars at opens 1789732800000 (2507.15 to 2578.60) and 1789747200000 (2579.97 to 2636.28).
The pullback from 2700 to 2568.16 retraces roughly half of the 2436.87-2700 advance and has not broken the last higher low, which is normal bull-trend behaviour rather than proof of a range top.
A window high at 2700 following a 2358.62 higher low can also be read as a bull channel inside a wider range, which would put the current pullback in the channel rather than at a range ceiling.
transition_conditions: Acceptance above 2700.00 - a close above it followed by another bull close - would move the read toward a bull breakout/trend rather than a range ceiling.
A close below 2568.16 followed by a lower high would confirm the 2700 rejection and favour rotation back toward the 2464-2507 area.
Continued small overlapping bars holding roughly 2568-2640 keeps the trading-range classification intact.
A break and close below 2436.87 would revive the bearish swing leg from opens 1789473600000-1789488000000.
